Name: A Potato Party - More Potato - Crops and Recipes
Author: xyariaa
Description:
[center][size=6]A Potato Party – Crops & Recipes[/size][/center]

It is the Great Mighty Potato birthday, so all of its potatoes friend came to the valley to celebrate! Indulge in this potato party, and scour the valley to discover all these new varieties and recipes~

[center][size=5]Features[/size][/center]
[left][/left]
[list]
[*]6 new Potato crops: Russet potato, La Ratte potato, Sweet potato, All-blue potato, All-red potato, Vivelotte potato,[/*]
[*]21 new Potato-based recipes: Aligot, Tater Tots, Twice Baked Potatoes, Potato Soup, French Fries, Okonomiyaki, Potato pancakes, Tartiflette, Honey Glazed Sweet Potatoes, Mallow Potato Casserole, Sweet Potato Pie, Sweet Potato Cookie, Blue Mashed Potato, Blue Curry, Purple Hasselback Potato, Unicorn Soup, Red Potato Casserole, Red Hashed Potato, Fingerling Duo, Rainbow Crisps, Party Salad[/*]
[/list]Both the crops and recipes are spread throughout the valley: look in every shop, including festival ones, to find them all!
